title: Economy: Cuba Plunges Into Darkness as U.S. Cuts Off Oil Supply
key_takeaways: Cubans are now facing severe power outages, with many homes and businesses left without electricity.
The decision to cut off oil supplies comes at a time when Cuba is already grappling with an economic downturn and shortages of basic goods.
The situation in Cuba highlights the complex geopolitical dynamics at play in the Caribbean region and underscores the challenges faced by countries dependent on foreign energy sources.
